# Sunset Forecast & Alerts

> Sunset scores every sunrise and sunset from 0 to 100 using the cloud, humidity and visibility forecast, with a free alert before the good ones.

## App

- [Sunset Forecast & Alerts](https://jackwallner.github.io/sunset/index.html.md): Sunset scores every sunrise and sunset from 0 to 100 using the cloud, humidity and visibility forecast, with a free alert before the good ones.
